reviews.selector: Uses the native duplicate path when available for SHA256 requests
reviews.relevance: Protects shipped native dispatch or the public managed scanner and explicit-root fd visibility; author is a separate specialist.
reviews.coverage: Root read all selectors and source; independently ran ten cases with real fd/Git and managed hashing: 10 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, 3.64 seconds. Author RED: 8 passed/2 failed before the one-argument production correction. Exact hash/membership rejects equal-size different bytes; local ignore/hidden and five filter cases reject broad traversal.
reviews.breaking_behavior: No assertion weakened. Real-fd cases skip only when fd is unavailable; managed case mocks discovery only. Native dispatch tests use scoped mocks and establish dispatch, not native hardware or DLL outage.
reviews.limits: No speedup, deployment or complete backend ignore parity claimed. Nonzero fd exit handling remains a pre-existing separately documented gap.
